## Summary
Claim C-1088 is in the High band (22.2 of 100, 90.1% coverage), driven mainly by NL-3 (shared clinic and attorney across 10 linked claims), BI-2 (unusual treatment growth), and NL-6 (a 12-claim cluster). The Challenger left all points unchanged after 3 rounds, but it noted that clinic-attorney overlap, early attorney retention, and subjective findings can each have ordinary explanations. This is a possible link that needs human review, not a finding of wrongdoing.

## What to check next
- **Network (NL-3, NL-6):** Review the shared Harrington Physical Therapy and David Richardson link across C-1085, C-1123, C-1297, C-1313, C-1318, C-1351, C-1355, C-1385, C-1463 and C-1496. Check whether anything beyond the shared pairing connects them, as the Challenger noted.
- **Treatment pattern (BI-2, BI-6, C-1088-adjuster_file p1):** Compare the move to nearly daily visits (15 in the first 30 days) with the therapist's treatment plan and records.
- **Medical support (BI-3, C-1088-medical_records p2; BI-5):** Confirm how the reported findings rest on self-report given the normal imaging and exams. Also check why the attorney was retained 2024-12-16 but the first visit was 2024-12-23.
